summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Transportation to study the benefits and obstacles of commuter rail trips that do not require transfers, including a cost-benefit analysis of such trips on the New Jersey Transit Raritan Valley line, and to report these findings to Congress.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the Secretary of Transportation to conduct a study on commuter rail passenger transportation, which will incur some cost for the government. However, the bill does not appropriate funds or establish a new program, so the spending is limited to the cost of the study itself, making its impact minor.
